title: Zeroth Order Energy
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly relate positronium energies to hydrogen energies using the appropriate formula.

title: Spin Degeneracy
description: Important Criteria: Acknowledge the 4-fold degeneracy of energy levels due to spin considerations.

title: Hamiltonian Formulation
description: Important Criteria: Properly express the Hamiltonian including spin-spin interactions and external magnetic field effects.

title: Energy Level Effects
description: Essential Criteria: Provide correct expressions for the energy levels after considering spin interactions and magnetic field effects.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid mistakes in the application of the reduced mass or incorrect signs in energy expressions.
